# opencode-go-quota An OpenCode Desktop GUI plugin that shows the OpenCode Go allowance in the titlebar. A ring pill sits in the window titlebar (top right): the OpenCode mark at the centre, and one arc per Go allowance window around it — monthly in white at the base, weekly in amber, and the rolling 5-hour window in blue on top. Hover it to open a card with the same numbers as bars; click it to open the Console usage page. ![hover card](docs/placement.png) ## Whose quota is it? The numbers come from `GET /api/experimental/usage/limits`, which answers one question: *for this location, which Console workspace is signed in, and what is its Go allowance?* Resolution order: 1. **Location** — the directory of the session you are looking at. The plugin passes `location.directory` on every request, so the answer follows the project you switched to. You can pin it with the `location` option instead. 2. **Credential** — the server's active credential for the `opencode` integration (the Console login). A machine has one active Console account at a time; the server stores it, the plugin never touches the secret. 3. **Workspace** — the Console workspace that credential belongs to. The card shows its name (`Default` here) and the project directory the answer was resolved from. So the card is not hardcoded to an account: it describes whatever workspace the current location resolves to, and it degrades cleanly when that is nothing. | Server answer | Pill | Card | |---|---|---| | workspace + Go meters | ring + `OpenCode Go · 21%` | three bars | | workspace, no Go plan | dimmed ring + `OpenCode Go · 未订阅` | Console budget bar, or a "no plan" note | | `data: null` (no Console login) | dimmed ring + `OpenCode Go · 未登录` | 未登录 | | request failed | dimmed ring + `OpenCode Go · 获取失败` | 获取失败 | | limit reached | red mark + `OpenCode Go · 已达上限` | 已达上限 | ## The card ``` OpenCode Go GO Default · zcodeplayground 滚动 5 小时 3.0% · 4 小时后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 本周 1.0% · 5 天后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 本月 0% · 30 天后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 更新于 刚刚 打开 Console ``` - The card follows the app's v2 `usage-dialog` style: 13px/440 type, 0.5px dividers, native `background-bg-base` / `border-border-base` / `elevation-floating` tokens, and 8px square bars filled with `background-bg-inverse` (white in dark theme). A reached limit turns the value and bar red. - The card uses the app's CSS variables, so it follows the current light or dark theme. - Percentages below 1% keep two decimals (`0.03%`), so light usage is visible. - Refreshes every `refreshSeconds`, when the active session changes, and when the window regains focus (at most once every 15 s). ## The titlebar icon `TitlebarItem.icon` only accepts one of the app's built-in icon names, so the ring is a small inline SVG that the plugin injects into its own pill: - 24 × 24 px, with the OpenCode mark in the centre; - a neutral 3.4 px track, then three arcs on the same centreline, clockwise from 12 o'clock; - monthly in white at 3.4 px (base), weekly in amber at 2.2 px, rolling 5 hours in blue at 1.2 px (top); - each arc spans its own percentage, so the exposed edge of a wider lower layer shows how the shorter window compares with the longer one; - loading hides the ring for the built-in spinner, missing data dims it, and a limit turns the mark red. The injection only targets horizontal titlebars. On a vertical titlebar the standard icon stays, so the plugin keeps working on layouts this patch does not cover. ## Options All optional, set on the plugin entry: ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "C:\\tools\\opencode-go-quota", "options": { "refreshSeconds": 60, "location": "C:\\work\\client-a", "openUrl": "https://opencode.ai/console" } } ] } ``` | Option | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `refreshSeconds` | `60` | Poll interval, clamped to 15–3600. | | `location` | active session directory | Directory used to resolve the Console workspace. Pin it when one machine should always report one account. | | `openUrl` | Console root | Fallback link when the server returns no `usageURL`. | | `apiKey` | unset | OpenCode Go API key. If set, API-key mode wins over the Console session. Stored in plain text in `opencode.json`. | ## Data source Console mode uses `ctx.client.usage.limits({ location: { directory } })` → `GET /api/experimental/usage/limits`. API-key mode uses `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` with `Authorization: Bearer `. The request runs in the desktop main process, because the endpoint's CORS preflight rejects the renderer's `Authorization` header. The API response is normalized into the same rolling/weekly/monthly meters. ```jsonc { "workspace": { "name": "Default", "usageURL": "…" }, "go": { "rolling": { "percent": 3.0, "limited": false, "resetsAt": 1793160000000 }, "weekly": { … }, "monthly": { … } }, "budgets": [] } ``` ## Sign-in modes The plugin ships no credentials. It supports two modes: - **Console session (default):** it asks the local OpenCode server, which uses the Console session the app already holds. Each user needs OpenCode Desktop 2.x, a signed-in Console account — **Account** in the app, or `/connect` → **OpenCode Console** in the TUI — and a Go or Go Plus subscription. - **API key:** hover the titlebar ring, click **Use API key** at the bottom of the card, paste the key into the card, and press **Sign in**. The command palette also has **OpenCode Go: Set OpenCode Go API Key**. The key is stored locally in plain text and sent only to `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`. Click **Sign out** in the card, or use **OpenCode Go: Forget OpenCode Go API Key**, to return to Console mode. `usage.limits` returns `data: null` for a location with no Console sign-in, and the card shows **未登录** with links to the Console and API-key login. Switching Console accounts happens in OpenCode, not in the card: the card always describes the account currently active for the location. ## Install ### From the release zip (no Node, no npm) 1. Download the latest zip from [Releases](https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota/releases/latest). 2. Extract the archive under `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\plugins\`. The folder name is arbitrary (the archive root is `opencode-go-quota`); it must contain `package.json` and `dist/gui-experimental.cjs` directly. 3. Start or restart OpenCode Desktop. Nothing else — package directories under `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` are discovered automatically, so the config stays untouched. If the pill does not appear, check **Settings › Extensions › Plugins** for `go-quota`, and `~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log` for a `loading plugin` line. ### From an arbitrary folder Extract anywhere permanent and point the global config at the directory: ```jsonc { "plugins": ["C:\\tools\\opencode-go-quota"] } ``` Relative paths resolve from the config file; a path to a single file is skipped. ### From GitHub The built bundle is committed under `dist/`, so the repository can be installed directly: ```powershell opencode plugin add github:boingsetta/opencode-go-quota ``` Or clone it into the plugins directory: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota ` "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\plugins\go-quota" ``` Restart OpenCode Desktop. The directory contains `package.json` and `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`; no build step is needed for installation. ### From source ```powershell git clone https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota cd opencode-go-quota npm install npm run build ``` `npm run build` writes `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`. The desktop app reloads plugins when the bundle changes, so no restart is needed after a rebuild. ## How the hover works `TitlebarItem` only renders an icon and a text label, so the card is drawn by the plugin: - one fixed-position element under `body`, 14 px from the window's right edge; - `pointermove` finds the pill through its accessible name (`aria-label` starting with `OpenCode Go`) and compares rectangles, so window moves, resizes and DPI changes do not matter; - the column from the pill down to the card counts as one hover surface, with a 300 ms grace period, so the pointer can cross the gap; - `pointerleave` and window `blur` close it; a hidden card is `pointer-events: none`. ## Develop ```powershell npx vite build --watch ``` Each rebuild reloads the GUI in every window. The bundle must stay one CommonJS file, which the `gui()` Vite preset guarantees. ## Uninstall Remove the `plugins` entry, or turn the GUI off in **Settings › Extensions › Plugins**. ## Notes and limits - The GUI plugin API is experimental (`./gui-experimental`); a future OpenCode release may need changes. - The endpoint reports one workspace per location. Multiple Console accounts on one machine are switched in OpenCode itself, not from this card — the credential API returns secrets, so the plugin deliberately does not read it. - Requires OpenCode Desktop 2.x with a signed-in Console account for `usage.limits` to return data. ## Links - Repository: https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota - License: MIT, see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

# opencode-go-quota 一个 OpenCode Desktop GUI 插件，在标题栏显示 OpenCode Go 额度。标题栏右上角有一个环形胶囊：中间是 OpenCode 标志，外圈三段弧分别表示三个额度窗口——本月为白色底弧，本周为琥珀色，滚动 5 小时为蓝色顶层。悬停打开卡片，用进度条显示同样的数字；点击可打开 Console 用量页。 ![悬停卡片](docs/placement.png) ## 额度属于谁？ 数字来自 `GET /api/experimental/usage/limits`，它回答一个问题： *对于当前目录，登录的是哪个 Console 工作区，它的 Go 额度是多少？* 解析顺序： 1. **位置** — 当前会话所在目录。插件每次请求都带 `location.directory`，所以切换到哪个项目，数字就跟随哪个项目。也可以用 `location` 选项固定。 2. **凭据** — 本地 OpenCode 服务中 `opencode` 集成的活动凭据（Console 登录）。一台机器同一时间只有一个活动 Console 账号；凭据由服务端保存，插件不会读取密钥。 3. **工作区** — 该凭据所属的 Console 工作区。卡片显示工作区名称（例如 `Default`）和解析所用的项目目录。 所以卡片不是硬编码到某个账号：它描述当前目录解析到的工作区；解析不到时会干净地降级。 | 服务端返回 | 胶囊 | 卡片 | |---|---|---| | 工作区 + Go 额度 | 环形图标 + `OpenCode Go · 21%` | 三条进度条 | | 工作区，但没有 Go 套餐 | 变暗的环形图标 + `OpenCode Go · 未订阅` | Console 预算条，或“未订阅”提示 | | `data: null`（没有 Console 登录） | 变暗的环形图标 + `OpenCode Go · 未登录` | 未登录 | | 请求失败 | 变暗的环形图标 + `OpenCode Go · 获取失败` | 获取失败 | | 达到上限 | 红色标志 + `OpenCode Go · 已达上限` | 已达上限 | ## 卡片 ``` OpenCode Go GO Default · zcodeplayground 滚动 5 小时 3.0% · 4 小时后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 本周 1.0% · 5 天后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 本月 0% · 30 天后重置 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 更新于 刚刚 打开 Console ``` - 卡片遵循应用 v2 `usage-dialog` 风格：13px/440 字体、0.5px 分隔线、原生 `background-bg-base` / `border-border-base` / `elevation-floating` token，以及 8px 方形进度条，填充色为 `background-bg-inverse`（深色主题下为白色）。达到上限时数值和进度条变红。 - 卡片使用应用的 CSS 变量，跟随当前浅色或深色主题。 - 小于 1% 的百分比保留两位小数（例如 `0.03%`），轻微用量也看得见。 - 每 `refreshSeconds` 刷新；切换活动会话、窗口重新获得焦点时也会刷新（最多 15 秒一次）。 ## 标题栏图标 `TitlebarItem.icon` 只接受应用内置的图标名，所以环形图标是插件注入到自己胶囊里的一小段内联 SVG： - 24 × 24 px，中心是 OpenCode 标志； - 一条 3.4 px 的中性底轨，然后同一圆心上的三段弧，从 12 点方向顺时针排列； - 本月为白色 3.4 px（底层），本周为琥珀色 2.2 px，滚动 5 小时为蓝色 1.2 px（顶层）； - 每段弧按自己的百分比绘制，所以较宽的下层边缘露出的长度，可以直观看出较短窗口与较长窗口的比例； - 加载时隐藏环形图标，显示内置 spinner；没有数据时变暗；达到上限时标志变红。 注入只针对水平标题栏。垂直标题栏下会保留标准图标，所以这个补丁没有覆盖的布局里插件仍然可用。 ## 选项 全部可选，写在插件条目上： ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "C:\\tools\\opencode-go-quota", "options": { "refreshSeconds": 60, "location": "C:\\work\\client-a", "openUrl": "https://opencode.ai/console" } } ] } ``` | 选项 | 默认值 | 含义 | |---|---|---| | `refreshSeconds` | `60` | 轮询间隔，限制在 15–3600 秒。 | | `location` | 当前会话目录 | 用于解析 Console 工作区的目录。固定后可让一台机器始终报告同一个账号。 | | `openUrl` | Console 根地址 | 服务端没有返回 `usageURL` 时的回退链接。 | | `apiKey` | 未设置 | OpenCode Go API Key。设置后 API Key 模式优先于 Console 会话。会以明文保存在 `opencode.json` 中。 | ## 数据来源 Console 模式使用 `ctx.client.usage.limits({ location: { directory } })` → `GET /api/experimental/usage/limits`。 API Key 模式使用 `GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`，并带上 `Authorization: Bearer `。请求在桌面主进程中执行，因为该接口的 CORS 预检会拒绝 渲染进程的 `Authorization` 头。API 响应会被归一化成同样的滚动 5 小时/本周/本月三个窗口。 ```jsonc { "workspace": { "name": "Default", "usageURL": "…" }, "go": { "rolling": { "percent": 3.0, "limited": false, "resetsAt": 1793160000000 }, "weekly": { … }, "monthly": { … } }, "budgets": [] } ``` ## 登录方式 插件不自带凭据，支持两种模式： - **Console 会话（默认）：** 向本地 OpenCode 服务查询，使用应用已有的 Console 登录。每个用户需要 OpenCode Desktop 2.x、已登录的 Console 账号（应用里的 **Account**，或 TUI 里的 `/connect` → **OpenCode Console**），以及 Go 或 Go Plus 订阅。 - **API Key：** 悬停标题栏环形图标，点击卡片底部的 **使用 API Key**，把 Key 粘贴到卡片里，点击 **登录**。命令面板里也有 **OpenCode Go: 设置 OpenCode Go API Key**。Key 会以明文保存在本地，只发送到 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`。点击卡片底部的 **退出 API Key**，或运行 **OpenCode Go: 清除 OpenCode Go API Key**，即可回到 Console 模式。 没有 Console 登录时，`usage.limits` 会返回 `data: null`，卡片显示 **未登录**，并提供 Console 和 API Key 登录入口。切换 Console 账号在 OpenCode 内完成，不在卡片里：卡片始终描述当前目录对应的工作区。 ## 安装 ### 从 Release zip 安装（不需要 Node/npm） 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota/releases/latest) 下载最新 zip。 2. 解压到 `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\plugins\`。文件夹名可以任意（压缩包根目录是 `opencode-go-quota`）；里面必须直接包含 `package.json` 和 `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`。 3. 启动或重启 OpenCode Desktop。 不需要其他操作——`~/.config/opencode/plugins/` 下的包目录会被自动发现，配置文件不用改。 如果胶囊没有出现，检查 **Settings › Extensions › Plugins** 里是否有 `go-quota`，并查看 `~/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log` 里是否有 `loading plugin` 记录。 ### 从任意文件夹安装 解压到任意永久目录，然后在全局配置里指向该目录： ```jsonc { "plugins": ["C:\\tools\\opencode-go-quota"] } ``` 相对路径从配置文件所在目录解析；指向单个文件的路径会被跳过。 ### 从 GitHub 安装 构建产物 `dist/` 已经提交，所以可以直接从仓库安装： ```powershell opencode plugin add github:boingsetta/opencode-go-quota ``` 或者克隆到插件目录： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota ` "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\plugins\go-quota" ``` 重启 OpenCode Desktop。目录里包含 `package.json` 和 `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`，安装不需要构建。 ### 从源码构建 ```powershell git clone https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota cd opencode-go-quota npm install npm run build ``` `npm run build` 会生成 `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`。桌面应用会在 bundle 变化时重新加载插件，重建后不需要重启。 ## 悬停如何工作 `TitlebarItem` 只渲染图标和文字标签，所以卡片是插件自己绘制的： - 一个固定定位的元素挂在 `body` 下，距离窗口右边缘 14 px； - `pointermove` 通过无障碍名称（以 `OpenCode Go` 开头的 `aria-label`）找到胶囊并比较矩形，所以窗口移动、缩放和 DPI 变化都不受影响； - 从胶囊到卡片的整列算作一个悬停区域，并带 300 ms 宽限期，指针可以跨过中间空隙； - `pointerleave` 和窗口 `blur` 会关闭卡片；隐藏的卡片是 `pointer-events: none`。 ## 开发 ```powershell npx vite build --watch ``` 每次重建都会重新加载所有窗口里的 GUI。bundle 必须保持单个 CommonJS 文件，`gui()` Vite 预设会保证这一点。 ## 卸载 移除 `plugins` 条目，或在 **Settings › Extensions › Plugins** 里关闭这个 GUI 插件。 ## 注意事项和限制 - GUI 插件 API 是实验性的（`./gui-experimental`）；未来的 OpenCode 版本可能需要适配。 - 接口按位置报告一个工作区。同一台机器上的多个 Console 账号是在 OpenCode 里切换的，不在卡片里——凭据 API 会返回密钥，所以插件刻意不去读取它。 - 需要 OpenCode Desktop 2.x，并且已登录 Console 账号，`usage.limits` 才会返回数据。 ## 链接 - 仓库：https://github.com/boingsetta/opencode-go-quota - 许可证：MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。
